backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver code for M_CAN v3.0 will not compile / will misprogram registers when ported to ≥ v3.1.0.
Mixing ISO + non-ISO CAN FD nodes on the same bus is NOT interoperable.

backward_compat_traps.with_WMM_eq_1: Wide Message Markers use 16-bit MM; internal Tx timestamping DISABLED in Tx Event FIFO.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Code expecting internal Tx timestamp will see empty TXTS field when WMM = 1.

backward_compat_traps.without_external_counter: TSCC.TSS = 01 works for Classical CAN only.
backward_compat_traps.trap: CAN FD frames timestamped with internal counter will have inaccurate timestamps across BRS switch.

key_changes.summary: Major: CAN FD support introduced; debug on CAN; dedicated Rx Buffers; Extension Interface.
FIFO overwrite mode + transmit pause + CAN FD 64-byte frame support.
Major register restructure for CAN FD: DBTP / NBTP / FDF / FDOE+BRSE / TDCR / interrupt flag renames.
CCCR.NISO bit added — selectable ISO 11898-1:2015 vs Bosch CAN FD V1.0.
Wide Message Markers (CCCR.WMM); DMU + TSU interfaces; CCCR.UTSU bit; Sync-message timestamping.
DTSEG2 range harmonized; Tx Buffer handling wording corrections.

fields.version_naming_history_note: M_CAN is Bosch's reference CAN-FD controller — successor to C_CAN (Classical CAN). M_CAN v3.1.0 (2014) was the major restructure that consolidated the CAN-FD register set. ISO 11898-1:2015 is the protocol standard M_CAN implements; Bosch CAN FD Specification V1.0 is the precursor non-ISO format selectable via CCCR.NISO. CAN FD is a frame-format-only extension of Classical CAN: same physical layer + ID semantics + arbitration, with three new control bits (FDF/BRS/ESI) + new DLC encoding + new CRC.
